meaning: A way for computers to learn from many examples. They do not only follow rules a person wrote.
clues: It is a way of getting computers to do useful things.
It is about teaching a computer a skill.
People show the computer many examples, and it finds the patterns by itself.
Photo apps that group pictures by face, and movie suggestions, use it.
It has two words. The first starts with M and the second starts with L.
assumes: Robotics means building machines that move
Virtual reality uses a headset to show a made-up world

decoys.meaning: Writing step-by-step instructions that tell a computer exactly what to do.
Designing and building machines that can move and do jobs.
Using a headset to feel as if you are inside a world made by a computer.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, a computer did exactly what you typed and nothing more. Now it learns from examples?

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Yes. Tip: if a photo app labels a face wrong, you can usually fix the name yourself.
